brief: A Mac app that restyles Apple Wallet card art on iPhone. The mark should feel premium, modern and next-gen — not a literal credit card, not a letter V.
criteria: Success: ownable and abstract, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, expresses one surface taking on a new look.

concepts.name: Overlap
concepts.idea: Two surfaces overlap and a new window opens where they meet — restyling made into a mark.
rationale: Abstract and ownable — not a card, not a V
Holds from 512 px down to a 16 px favicon
One shape, one radius system; works in a single colour and reversed
Pairs with a clean geometric 'veyro' wordmark

recommendation: Overlap — the clearest expression of restyling, premium and next-gen, strong at every size.
next_steps: Final wordmark outlined from a geometric typeface
Roll out across the app icon, website and store art
